Not in the UAE directory section ("All Brands"); appears only in the site-wide popular-designers sidebar. Prada is Italian.
Supported (2023 artisan finalist) but understated: the page also names SAMAR 2024 Artisan winner (Grove is in the Heart)
Not in the UAE directory section; sidebar only. French house.

add_brands.says: built the first rose distillery in Bulgaria (Tarnichene, 1909); "for the high quality of Rose oil, the distillery was awarded a gold medal by UNESCO" (Plovdiv 1964); clients Yardley and Paris/Vienna/Milan/New York perfumers

Deraah Perfumes holds 6.1% of the Saudi perfume market (2022), third local player after Arabian Oud (12.5%) and Abdul Samad Al Qurashi (9.4%) (AlJazira Capital research); parent of the RING perfume line on Fragrantica

Vallauris (near Grasse) natural aromatic raw-material house, origins 1920; "exceptional savoir-faire in the realm of aromatic plants", 100% pure single-origin naturals for perfumers (acquirer Givaudan's release: not independent, tier with care)
Fragrance Foundation FiFi Perfume Extraordinaire of the Year credited to Robertet in 2018 (Atelier Cologne Café Tuberosa) and 2013 (Byredo Black Saffron); Grasse naturals and fragrance house
FiFi Perfume Extraordinaire of the Year 2014 credited to MANE (Aedes de Venustas Iris Nazarena, perfumer Ralf Schwieger); Grasse-region fragrance and raw-material house
add_brands.note: name "Mane" is generic; check homonyms at merge

add_brands.says: FiFi Perfume Extraordinaire of the Year credited to Symrise in 2017 (Parfums Quartana Poppy Soma) and 2019 (A Lab On Fire Hallucinogenic Pearl)
FiFi Perfume Extraordinaire of the Year 2021: Plum in Cognac (IFF, Pascal Gaurin)
FiFi Perfume Extraordinaire of the Year 2019: Hallucinogenic Pearl (Symrise, Emilie Bevierre-Coppermann)
FiFi Perfume Extraordinaire of the Year 2015: Perfume Calligraphy Saffron (IFF, Clement Gavarry)
FiFi 2012 Indie Fragrance of the Year: Odin New York 06 Amanu (Foundry NYC)
FiFi 2023 Innovative Fragrance Product of the Year: Veronique Gabai Aroma Heart (DSM-Firmenich)
Kannauj attar distillery named by AFP (Taipei Times 2012) as one of the small traditional businesses keeping deg-bhapka attar alive in "the perfume capital of India"

Taif rose distillery "established in 1831 and is the oldest in the Kingdom" (Arab News), seventh-generation family firm; rose oil sold as deluxe perfume; supplies rose water and perfume to wash the Kaaba

Latvian public broadcaster LSM: "one of the country's best-known brands", roots in H.A. Briger's Riga soap and perfumery factory (1849), popular through the Soviet period; Fragrantica lists 473 Dzintars perfumes

perfume oil created 1920s by W.J. Bush (now an IFF brand): "Africa's number one bestseller", cultural weight compared to Chanel No.5, "still very much part of the culture" in West, Central and North-East Africa (perfume webzine interview with IFF regional manager; IFF owns the brand, so standing only)
Ghanaian house (Ghandour Cosmetics): "the first African fragrance house to go resolutely up-market" (Premium Beauty News, trade press); also named as a key indie player by BeautyMatter
Botswana indie house (marula-oil perfumes), named by BeautyMatter as one of the African brands "emerging as global players in niche perfume markets"
Cape Town indie perfumer named by BeautyMatter among African "key competitors" in niche perfume
Asia Perfume Awards 2025 Brand Award winner (expert-judged; judges incl. Erica Moore)
Asia Perfume Awards 2025 Brand Award winner (expert-judged)
Singapore niche house (2020); Business Times: "the International Perfume Museum in Grasse selected its Nanyang fragrance for its exhibition of iconic Asian perfumes" (museum selection)
Marie Claire Türkiye Fragrance Awards 2026 (jury, blind smelling, scored): Best Niche Perfume (Gold)
Marie Claire Türkiye Fragrance Awards 2026 (jury, blind smelling, scored): Best Unisex Perfume (Fig Royale)
Marie Claire Türkiye Fragrance Awards 2026 (jury, blind smelling, scored): Science and Craft in Perfumery award, for reinterpreting traditional enfleurage
Fragrance Foundation France Awards 2025, Prix du Meilleur Parfum de Niche, independent brand (Estrella de la Mañana; jury of evaluators and fragrance journalists, 102 entries)
Fragrance Foundation France Awards 2025, Prix du Meilleur Parfum de Niche, young independent brand (Tobacco Memories)

Paris atomiser maker founded 1882 by Léopold Franck; Fragrantica history feature: "has contributed to the miniaturization of atomizers. The first Marcel Franck travel atomizer was made and patented in 1912"; bulb atomisers sought by collectors
founded in Belém (Amazon) in 1930, now part of Granado; loved for old-fashioned soaps and colognes, "the Brazilian bathroom-cabinet smell many people grew up with" (editorial list; app magazine)
Peruvian catalogue beauty and fragrance house, everyday perfume across the Andean countries (editorial list)

add_regions.speciality: Bulgarian rose oil (Rosa damascena), EU PGI "Bulgarsko rozovo maslo" registered 2014 (designation)
add_regions.note: designation (PGI); the PGI page names no producers, src2 names Enio Bonchev and says "Bulgarians - the greatest masters of the Rose oil production"

add_regions.speciality: attar by deg-bhapka distillation; Kannauj Perfume GI (designation)
add_regions.quote: "Kannauj is to India what Grasse is to France. Here perfume-making is art."
add_regions.note: independent AFP page to back the harvest region (whose GI page names no houses and whose two houses rest on own sites); also names Gulab Singh Johrimal (Old Delhi, family business since 1816; tourists flock "because of the natural and organic quality") as independent support for the harvest row Gulabsingh Johrimal (register: Gulab Singh Johrimal, same company). M.L. Ramnarain still rests only on its own site: listed.

add_regions.speciality: Taif rose (Rosa damascena trigintipetala) oil and rose water distilled each spring
add_regions.quote: "Taif roses, renowned for their exceptional aroma ... among the Kingdom's most valuable natural perfume products"
add_regions.note: SPA is the state news agency (independent of makers); brand named on src2

add_regions.speciality: cut and coloured Bohemian crystal perfume bottles and atomisers, 1920s-30s boom
add_regions.quote: "Bohemian Crystal and Czech art glass have long been revered internationally for their workmanship and beauty."
add_regions.note: museum (Czech Center Museum Houston) collection page; names no makers. A dealer page (http://www.czechgallery.com/perfume_bottles/history.html) names Heinrich Hoffmann (register) and Henry G. Schlevogt as the luxury makers, but it is a seller page: use only as a pointer

add_regions.speciality: Latin America's strongest home-grown perfume industry: Natura, O Boticário, Granado (1870), Phebo (1930)
add_regions.quote: "Brazil has the strongest home-grown perfume industry in the region."
add_regions.note: WhatScent is an app magazine (same source type the harvest used for the Gulf region): weak renown source. Granado is in the register as H1 only; this page shows colognes and EDPs (add H4)
